summary:
All five `letters` frames were reached, captured and diffed numerically and visually with the `v-letters-` prefix, plus the three boards these files also draw (`Letter Received` #43, `Letter Week XII` #44 via /letter?variant=week12, and `Medallion Received` #45 via /medallion-post). The recipes in `.vicifull/recipes/letters.json` are accurate and every one of them worked first time; nothing was unreachable. The implementation holds up.
